hook.text: The richest people at the party wear jeans. The moderately rich wear designer suits. Why?

buildup.text: Countersignaling: when those at the very top don't signal at all, while the middle stratum signals hardest.

discovery.text: The truly wealthy don't need to prove anything. Their status is already known. Only the insecure must display it.

twist.text: In academia, the most respected professors publish less. Their reputation precedes them.

climax.text: Countersignaling creates a paradox: not signaling can itself become the strongest signal of status.

punchline.text: Not trying is the ultimate flex.

quiz.question: What is countersignaling?
options: High-status individuals not bothering to signal because they don't need to
